angle: Our brains don't replay memories, they reconstruct them, often inaccurately, due to the influence of emotions and external suggestions
hook: Memories are not what they seem
caption:
Have you ever recalled a childhood memory, only to find out it was false? Our brains have a remarkable ability to create and recreate memories, but this process can be flawed. This reconstruction can be influenced by our emotions, suggestions from others, and even our own biases. What's the most significant memory you're not sure is entirely true? 
   #MemoryDistortion #FalseMemories #PsychologyOfMemory #Neuroplasticity #BrainFunction #MindBlown #MemoryKeepers #CognitiveBiases
